_comment: HAND-EDITED ONLY. Real-device results: src/lib/fonts/compat-results.ts joins these to results/automated.json (generated by `pnpm test`) by cell id, and /compat renders the merge. Fill `old` and `new` with true (pass), false (fail), or leave null (untested, rendered as `?`). Every cell in the /compat Quick matrix (5 meaningful use-site rows x 2 @font-face columns = 10 cells) has an `old` (Safari 18.7) and a `new` (current Safari) slot; the last three cells (upright-control, synthesis, fvs-descriptor) are not in that grid and are still untested. Every id shown on /compat must have an entry here.

oblique-angle.note: tested against the shipped family (normal + oblique faces together)

fvs-anywhere-B.note: no detail section of its own: shown in the matrix on the ranged-face row (EXPLICIT_SLNT_ANYWHERE in the page)

upright-control.note: the matrix's "nothing set" column; not yet device-checked

fvs-descriptor.note: historical, do not use; not device-checked
